# LevelHeadNicks

Sets the displayed LevelHead level for nicked players from an agent option.

- Type: `java-agent`
- Risk: `server-dependent`
- Install policy: `confirmation-required`
- Distribution: `github-release`

Sets the displayed LevelHead level for nicked players from an agent option.
